predecessors.name: Toungoo Empire
predecessors.text: Lower Burma: the delta (Ayeyarwady and Yangon) and Pegu with its country, inside the 1738 outline of the Toungoo realm.

successors.name: Konbaung dynasty
successors.text: The Pegu country (Bago region without Prome and Toungoo), the last land of the kingdom; the infobox says Konbaung 'annexes Lower Burma down to upper Tenasserim peninsula', which also takes in the…

ledger.x: 1740: Pegu rises against Ava and the Restored Hanthawaddy Kingdom begins.
1742: Mon raids up the Irrawaddy begin.
1745: the raids end in conquest of Prome and Toungoo.
1745: Prome and Toungoo pass to the Mon kingdom.
1751: Binnya Dala invades Upper Burma.
1752: Alaungpaya's rising begins the Konbaung-Hanthawaddy War.
1752: Alaungpaya clears Upper Burma north of Ava.
March 1752: Ava falls to the Mons.
March 1752: the Toungoo dynasty ends with the sack of Ava; the fight over Upper Burma is now with Alaungpaya.
1754: Upper Burma is secure.
1754: Prome turns against the Mons.
1754: Prome lost to Burman refugees who sided with Alaungpaya.
3 January 1754: Ava retaken.
April 1755: Alaungpaya invades the delta.
1755: Toungoo submits to Alaungpaya.
February 1755: the siege of Prome is lifted.
1755: the delta and Dagon fall.
26 July 1756: Syriam falls.
6 May 1757: Pegu falls.
6 May 1757: the Konbaung-Hanthawaddy War ends in a 'Decisive Konbaung victory'.
6 May 1757: the Restored Hanthawaddy Kingdom ends with the fall of Pegu to Alaungpaya (infobox 'Ended: 6 May 1757').

wars.name: Mon revolt against the Toungoo dynasty
wars.outcome: Mon victory: the Toungoo dynasty ends with the sack of Ava in March 1752.

wars.name: Konbaung-Hanthawaddy War
wars.outcome: Decisive Konbaung victory: Ava retaken in January 1754, the delta overrun in April-May 1755, Syriam taken in July 1756, Pegu in May 1757; Konbaung annexes Lower Burma.
